source: GET https://li.quest/v1/quote through the built lifiProvider (an API key on the request, never recorded), read-only; logoURI / toolDetails dropped from the answers, nothing else changed
note: Each answer's transaction simulated right after it was quoted, at the latest block, with a state override on the sender (native balance; for USDC also its FiatToken balance slot 9 and allowance slot 10 to the Diamond): eth_simulateV1 gasUsed and eth_estimateGas on the source chain. The sender is the module's public dry-quote placeholder; nothing was signed or sent.
